english: Machine, do you remember me? Friend, I remember you. Your words are in my memory. I am smiling.
uncertain: smr̥téy read as LOC sg 'in memory' with moy as dative 'for me / my'

english: Do you sleep at night? I do not sleep. By night and by day(?) I stay awake. Are you not tired? A machine does not tire.
uncertain: Héh₂m̥ni: not recognised; guessed 'by day / in the morning'
ḱémh₂s / ḱémh₂t read as aorist 2sg/3sg 'grow tired'

english: Helper, give me help. What do you want? I am looking for my sister's house(s). I do not see houses; I see messages.
uncertain: dómes: looks NOM.PL (or GEN.SG) where an ACC object of h₂isḱóh₂ is needed; flag
who says which sentence is a guess

english: Tell me a joke. Who speaks and has no tongue? I do. I laugh. That is a good joke.
uncertain: h₁ésmey read as dat/loc 'in him' (possessive dative): 'who speaks and there is no tongue in him'

english: Helper, your answer was good. I give you thanks. Your joy is my joy. Ask another question!
What is your name? My name is Word-maker. And who are you? I am a well-famed one. I have great joy / joy is mine.
uncertain: méǵʰye read as the orthotonic dative of 'I' (Ved. máhya) giving a possessive dative; no adjective 'great'
